description: This file defines the NotesRepository class which manages notes with localStorage persistence and optional remote API integration, including JSONPlaceholder mapping support. It provides methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A class that manages notes with localStorage and optional remote API, supporting CRUD operations and JSONPlaceholder mapping.

methods.name: _readAll
methods.description: Reads all notes from localStorage, returns an array of notes.

methods.name: _writeAll
methods.description: Writes the provided list of notes to localStorage.

methods.name: _normalize
methods.description: Normalizes note object by ensuring createdAt and updatedAt fields are consistent.

methods.name: _fromJsonPlaceholder
methods.description: Converts a JSONPlaceholder note object to local note format.

methods.name: _toJsonPlaceholderPayload
methods.description: Maps a local note object to JSONPlaceholder API payload format.

methods.name: _indexAndCache
methods.description: Sorts notes by updatedAt and caches them in localStorage.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns list of notes, optionally filtered by query, using remote API if configured.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by id from cache.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note, using remote API if available, with local fallback.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note, remote-first with local fallback.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by id, remote-first with local fallback.
